content:
maya: Quick usability review — spending chart sparklines + invoice line items. I'm worried the legend and org vs project defaults are confusing in the current mock. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/s/abc123

alex: +1. Sparklines look nice but legend order is inconsistent with the table below. when you collapse to org view, project-level hover disappears which folks rely on.

jordan: Agree. Could we show a lightweight breakdown on hover: total + top 3 projects? e.g. hover tooltip -> "Total: $X, Top: proj-a (40%), proj-b (25%), proj-c (10%)"

liam: Accessibility note: some of the sparkline colors fail contrast in dark mode (fails 3:1). We should run WCAG checks and pick a high-contrast palette for the primary/secondary series.

samira: Also invoice line items: currently tokens and cost are separate rows; customers asked to see token->cost mapping inline. Proposal: show "12.3M tokens ($123.45)" as a single column with a tiny tooltip for pricing tiers.

maya: Design question: default to org-level view or project-first? Sales says some enterprise users expect project-first, but product analytics show mixed usage.

alex: Data FYI — last quarter ~40% of dashboard sessions used org-scoped view by default. I think default to org with a prominent project toggle and a "remember my preference" checkbox.

jordan: Copy nits: change "Token breakdown" to "Usage breakdown (tokens)". Invoice CTA "Download CSV" -> "Export invoice" (more discoverable).

design-bot: Heads up: color palette v4 rolled out yesterday — update components/Charts.tsx. Link: https://internal.design/palettes/v4 :warning:

liam: Proposed aria additions: aria-label="sparkline: 30-day spend" on the chart svg, and aria-describedby pointing at the legend explanation for screen readers. Also ensure each legend item has role="listitem" inside a list.

maya: Prototype snippet in Figma + code sample for the small sparkline component: 
```jsx
<Sparkline
  data={last30Days}
  ariaLabel="30-day spend"
  showMiniLegend
  theme="v4"
/>
```

samira: If users collapse to project view, keep an org breadcrumb and the toggle visible. Agree with the "remember my preference" toggle — saves clicks for large orgs.

alex: I'll update the mock and tag PMs. @jordan can you run the contrast audit? @liam can you add the aria props to the component?

jordan: :white_check_mark: Will run axe + manual checks against v4 palette. I'll post a short report in this thread.

liam: :thumbsup: I'll add aria-label + describedby and send a tiny PR with unit tests for accessibility attributes.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post updated Figma by EOD and attach a new prototype link here. If anyone has strong objections to org-first default, flag now.
